name: Trishna Lovley
title: Principal/Director, Digital Twins
bio: Trishna Lovley is a digital transformation strategist who leads Booz Allen’s digital twin business within our Chief Technology Office. With expertise in large-scale innovation and transformation strategy, business development, and product management, she manages the implementation of digital twin pilots, prototypes, and enterprise-scale efforts. Trishna helps our clients with initiatives that operationalize digital twin technologies to address specific mission needs. Based in Massachusetts, Trishna also drives market relationships to innovate additional digital twin use cases. Prior to joining Booz Allen, Trishna worked in the digital marketing space where she developed immersive virtual and augmented reality product experiences. Trishna holds an M.Ed. in human development and psychology from Harvard University and a B.A. from Brandeis University.
